objective: Create a structured local release workbook from the QSEN Prelicensure to AACN Entry Level competency crosswalk workbook.
blocking_rules: Do not modify source workbook or source archive.
Treat Entry Level as the canonical source for QSEN rows and aggregate AACN mappings.
Use rows 1-5 as metadata/header rows and rows 6+ as data rows.
Forward-fill blank QSEN domain and KSA values caused by merged-cell layout.
Use the 10 domain sheets only for QA reconciliation.
Preserve raw source labels and typos exactly in *_raw fields.
Do not invent mappings; ambiguous, malformed, duplicate, or parent-prefix-mismatched mappings must be flagged needs_review.

jobs.title: Confirm local workset inputs and output contract
jobs.objective: Confirm source files, workset folder, release workbook name, QA artifact names, and read-only source policy.

jobs.title: Inventory workbook sheets and source shape
jobs.objective: Profile sheet names, dimensions, header rows, data rows, mapped cells, and source hash.
validation_checks: Entry Level data row count equals 214
Entry Level mapped cell count equals 651 before splitting multi-code cells

jobs.title: Normalize canonical QSEN rows and AACN mapping cells
jobs.objective: Forward-fill merged QSEN fields, split comma-separated subcompetency codes, preserve raw cells, and flag review conditions.
validation_checks: no source row is silently dropped
raw mapping cell values are preserved

jobs.title: Build dimensions and fact table
jobs.objective: Build QSEN domain, KSA, AACN domain, AACN competency, and QSEN statement tables.
validation_checks: fact statement count matches normalized source rows

jobs.title: Build QSEN to AACN bridge table
jobs.objective: Create one bridge row per QSEN statement to AACN subcompetency code while preserving source row and cell provenance.
validation_checks: duplicate and malformed codes are flagged

jobs.title: Build flattened canonical master
jobs.objective: Join normalized QSEN rows, AACN competency metadata, subcompetency mappings, provenance, and review status into a release table.
validation_checks: master bridge row count matches bridge table

jobs.title: Build coverage and review outputs
jobs.objective: Summarize mapping coverage by QSEN domain, KSA, AACN domain, and review reason.
validation_checks: review queue count matches QA JSON

jobs.title: Assemble Excel release workbook
jobs.objective: Create the final local workbook with README, Summary, Provenance, Data Dictionary, dimensions, fact, bridge, master, coverage, and review queue sheets.

jobs.title: Validate release and write QA manifest
jobs.objective: Write QA JSON with source hash, source counts, bridge counts, review queue count, and reconciliation status.
